title: Mixed Conditionals / Laaltuwwan Mararraa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, laaltuwwan mararraa hanga duubii qabdu si hinqabne: qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee hinqabne. Afaan Ingilizii, qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne: laaltu (if-clause) fi deebii (main clause) qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne. Laaltuwwan mararraa afaan Oromootiin afaan Ingilizii malee hinqabne; qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne.
rule: Laaltuwwan mararraa qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne (noola 3 + noola 2) yookiin qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne (noola 2 + noola 3). Qooda 1: If + past perfect, would + base verb (qooda waqtichaa, qooda deebii). Misala: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. Qooda 2: If + simple past, would have + past participle (qooda waqtichaa, qooda deebii). Misala: If I were you, I would have told her the truth. Laallotu: Laaltuwwan mararraa, 'were' 'was' fi 'had' 'had' hinqabne. Kanarraa, qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee hinqabne, laakin komaa qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne. Qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne: qooda waqtichaa fi qooda deebii qooda waqtichaa tokko tokkoon malee qabdu si qabne.

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Qabduu baafachuu irra jiru: Gerund, Infinitive, fi Modals
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, qabduu baafachuu harki ‘ser + participio’ jechuun isa ani dhaabbata, akkasumas fannaan lamaan dhiisuu akkasumas fannaan lamaan dhiisuu (gerundio/infinitivo) hunda beeku. Afaan Ingilizii, qabduu baafachuu bira jiraatu: ‘must be done’, ‘being done’, ‘to be done’, akkuma jedhanii. Akkasumas, Afaan Ingilizii, fannaan lamaan dhiisuu (akakaa ‘by someone’ jechuun) hin qabdu, garu Afaan Oromootti, akakaa kun hin qabnu.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii, qabduu baafachuu irra jiru ‘to be’ jechuun isa ani dhaabbata, modals akkasumas fannaan lamaan dhiisuu (gerundio/infinitivo) hunda beeku. Modals: modal + be + participio (ol: ‘must be done’, ‘can be seen’). Infinitivos: to be + participio (ol: ‘to be considered’). Gerundios: being + participio (ol: ‘being watched’). Modals irra jiru: modal + have been + participio (ol: ‘should have been informed’). Akkasumas, qabduu baafachuu preposition hunda beeku: ‘This chair was sat on’ (garu kan bira jiraachu). Fannaan lamaan dhiisuu (intransitivos) fi fannaan lamaan dhiisuu hin qabdu: akakaa kun hin qabnu.

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Qabxii sirnaa dheeraa
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uu dandeessan, qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha. Kana malee, afaan Oromoo keessatti qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha. ‘She says she is tired’ jedhanii ‘She said she was tired’ jechuudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha. ‘Will’ jedhanii ‘would’ jechuudha, ‘can’ jedhanii ‘could’ jechuudha, ta’ummaa lamaan keessattis wajjin hojii qabaachuu qaba. Qorophii harkisaa keessatti, afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘He said to come’ jedhaa ‘He said that I should come’ jechuudha. Adda baasuu fi barumsaa qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha (today → that day, here → there).
rule:
Qabxii sirnaa dheeraa afaan Ingilizii keessatti (qabxii B2):
1. **Backshift (hojii qaba)**: Qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha (said, told, asked), qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha: present simple → past simple; present continuous → past continuous; past simple → past perfect; present perfect → past perfect; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (yooki must jiraachuu).
2. **Hojii qaba hin dandeessan**: Hojii qaba hin dandeessan qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha (haa isaanii wajjin hojii qabaachuu qaba): ‘He said he is ill’ (isa ani beeka) yooki ‘He said he was ill’ (isa ani hin beeka).
3. **Qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha**: Qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha: ‘I’ → ‘he/she’, ‘my’ → ‘his/her’, haasa’aa.
4. **Qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha**: today → that day; yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day / the following day; here → there; now → then.
5. **Gadaa’uu qabxii sirnaa dheeraa**: Gadaa’uu qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha ‘if/whether’ jechuudha, gadaa’uu qabxii sirnaa dheeraa irra deebi’uudha. ‘Do/does/did’ hin baran.
6. **Haalumuu fi cabsee**: ‘Tell/ask + objeto + infinitivo’ jechuudha: ‘He told me to close the door.’ ‘That’ hin baran.
7. **Qabxii sirnaa dheeraa**: ‘Would’, ‘could’, ‘might’, ‘should’, ‘ought to’ hin qabdu. ‘Must’ yooki ‘had to’ jechuudha.

title: Inversion for Emphasis / Inversionii hojii keessatti
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, hojii keessatti himatanis haala dhaabbataa yookaanamtoota seenaa barbaachisaa akkaan taasifne ("Kan duraa hin beekne"). Afaan Ingilizii, gara, hin laallatu, guyyaa dhaabbataa yookaanamtoota seenaa barbaachisaa (rarely, not only, never, etc.) seera qolee amanas ibsuu akkaan, garuu isaa ta’uu argachuu qaba. Inversionii kuni qajeelfama hin jiru: kana hin qabne, ibsuu afaan Ingilizii isa standard akka taanaan ta’e barbaachisaa. Akkasumas hin taaneef, barbaachisaa afaan Ispeenichii kana hin qabneef jechuudha.
rule: Inversionii hojii keessatti akkasumas barbaachisaa yookaanamtoota seenaa barbaachisaa qolee ibsuu akkaan kan ta’e jechuudha. Yookaanamtoota seenaa barbaachisaa kana godhan: never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, not only, no sooner, little, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way. Akkasumas: [Barbaachisaa seenaa/barbaachisaa] + ta’ummaa (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, etc.) + macaafni + haala dhaabbataa. Ta’ummaa hin jiranii, ‘do’ hojii keessatti ‘did’ gara fuulduraa dhaabachuu qaba. ‘Not only’ keessaa, inversionii qolaa kamaasuu akkaan qaba: "Not only did she sing, but she also danced". ‘No sooner’ keessaa, gara fuulduraa dhaabachuu qaba: "No sooner had we arrived than it started raining". Kanaa akkasumas hojii keessatti yookaanamtoota seenaa barbaachisaa qolee ibsuu akkaan kan ta’e jechuudha. Akkasumas hojii keessatti hin taaneef, barbaachisaa afaan Ispeenichii kana hin qabneef jechuudha.

title: Cleft sentences (It is/was... that) / Gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha kana malee qorichiisuu miti. Afaan Ingilizitti, 'it' + 'to be' + gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha + 'that/who' + gaaffiiwwan miidhaa. Guyyaa akkasii: Afaan Ingilizitti, 'it' barbaachisaa ta'e malee, 'that' 'who' bolii irra deebisuu danda'a, 'which' barbaachisuu miti. Akkasumas, gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha afaan Oromootti kan biraa adaa ta'e jechuu danda'a.
rule: Gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha. Gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha: 'It' + 'to be' (hanga amma ffannaa) + gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha (gaaffaa, gaaffaa, gaaffaa, gaaffaa) + gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha ('that', 'who', 'whom', 'whose') + gaaffiiwwan miidhaa. Hanga duubatti, 'who' (gaaffaa) ama 'whom' (gaaffaa, garuu balaa). Hanga miidhaaf, 'that' (ama 'which' balaa). Hanga amma 'is', hanga ffannaa 'was'. 'It's' hanga ffannaa barbaachisuu miti (khataa tahee), 'it was' barbaachisa. Gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha gaaffaa, gaaffaa, gaaffaa ama gaaffaa. Fakkeenya: 'It was Maria who called me.' / 'It is the weekend that I enjoy the most.' / 'It was in Paris that we met.' / 'It is because of you that I came.' 'What' (what-clauses): 'What I need is a coffee.' Kanarrissumma, 'what' barbaachisaa ta'e malee, 'it' barbaachisuu miti. Miidhaa akakaa: 'The reason why...', 'The thing that...', 'The person who...', garuu 'it' fi 'what' miidhaa akakaa. Seenaa: 'it' gaaffiiwwan ajjeecha (miidhaa akakaa 'what...do'). Godhataa, 'It wasn't...' ama 'It isn't...'.

title: Nominalisation: Turning Verbs and Adjectives into Nouns / Maqaa fi Adjectivesitti Waraanaa Godhatee
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, maqaa godhataa barreeffama kana qabnaa fi qindaa’eeraa keessatti argamuu danda'a. ‘The discovery of’ hin ‘they discovered’ jechuun godha. Afaan Ispeenichii ummata hin kennu; sababni walqixxummaa maqaa godhataa (el descubrir) barbaachisaati. Afaan Ingilizii walqixxummaa maqaa godhataa -tion, -ment, -ness jecha fakkeenyaa qophaa’uu barbaada. Haala dhiiraa: hundi maqaa qabduwwan maqaa godhataa hin qabneefi, seera qabduwwan maqaa godhataa fi maqaa qabduwwan seera wal barbaachisaa. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, maqaa godhataa (or 'of') maqaa qabduwwan deebii barbaada; Afaan Ispeenichii keessatti garuu, 'de' maqaa qabduwwan deebii barbaada.
rule:
B2 keessatti, qorophii kana haa ilaaluu:
1. Maqaa qabduwwan → maqaa godhataa walqixxummaa: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ance/-ence (perform → performance), -al (approve → approval), -ure (fail → failure).
2. Adjectives → maqaa godhataa: -ness (happy → happiness), -ity (active → activity), -th (strong → strength), -ce (important → importance).
3. Seera harmee: choose → choice, believe → belief, prove → proof, lose → loss.
4. Seera qabu: Afaan Ingilizii qindaa’eeraa keessatti ‘the implementation of the plan’ hinjeolu ‘they implemented the plan’ jechuu godha. ‘Make’ + maqaa godhataa: ‘make a decision’ hinjeolu ‘decide’ jechuu godha.
5. Haalaan harmee: hundi maqaa qabduwwan hin kennu (change → change), fi hundi maqaa godhataa manaa tokko duuba kennu (relation vs. relationship).

title: Advanced Modal Verbs: Would Have, Should Have, etc. / Afaan Ingilizii keessaa modaalota guddaa: would have, should have, etc.
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessaa, guyyaa kanaa kan biraa hin kennamne ofiisaatiifii qabdu (habría hecho, debería haber hecho) kana malee jeeqota (imperfecto de subjuntivo) hin kennamne. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti geessii modaalota (would, should, could, might) 'have' fi baasee baqalaa hin qabnamne. Deebii keessaa tokko ilaalchisee Afaan Oromo keessaa 'haber' + baasee baqalaa hin qabne garuu Afaan Ingilizii keessatti modaalota + 'have' + baasee baqalaa hin qabna.
rule: Modaalota (would, should, could, might, must) + 'have' + baasee baqalaa hin qabna. Kana malee jechuunis jeeqotaa baasee baqalaa hin qabne (would have), maaltu hin qabne akkasumas baasee baqalaa hin qabne (should have), haasa'aa hin qabne (could have, might have), fi baasee baqalaa hin qabne (must have). Seenaa keessatti, 'not' modaalota hin deebi'e (should not have / shouldn't have). Galataa keessatti, faayidaa hin deebi'e (Would you have...?). Qindooqaa tokko tokko: would've, should've, could've. Haala malee jechuunis: 'must have' haala dhaabbata hin qabne (couldn't have kana was not allowed to hin qabne).

title: Formal Subjunctive / Subjuntivo formal (it is essential that he be...)
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, subjuntivoo modhaa fi’ii irra hin jiru malee, akkaataa kan ta’ee itti fayyadamu godhamee jira. Afaan Ispeenii keessatti garuu, subjuntivoo modhaa dursaa fi’ii dha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, subjuntivoo formaalaa (kan mandative subjunctive jedhanii) kana malees hin jiru garuu, akkaataa formaalaa fi akadeemikii keessumaa jira. Akkasumas, akka ‘it is essential that…’, ‘I demand that…’ fi ‘the doctor recommended that…’ jedhuu malee itti fayyadamu godhamee jira. Afaan Ispeenii dhiisuu, subjuntivoo Ingiliziin kanarraa fi’ii hin jiru malee, akkasumas akkaataa sadii tokko duubatti (be hinokkuu is) fi beehimaa (I be, you be, he be) irratti kan hin jiru. Bara Ispeeniiwwan akkasii godhanii waan hin kennamne garuu, akkasumas akkaataa formaalaa keessatti subjuntivoo godhu hin jiru.
rule: Subjuntivoo formaalaa afaan Ingilizii keessatti akkaataa kan biraa fi’ii danda’an, akkasumas akkaataa kan godhuu, akkasumas akkaataa kan guyyaa fi akkasumas akkaataa kan amantii irratti itti fayyadamu godhamee jira. Fakkeenya: ‘that + maqaa + fi’ii’ (infinitive hinokkuu ‘to’). Akkasumas, -s hin jiru sadii tokko duubatti. Fi’ii ‘be’ akkasumas fi’ii ‘be’ irra hin jiru maqii tokko duubatti. Akkasumas, akkaataa ‘demand’, ‘insist’, ‘recommend’, ‘suggest’, ‘ask’, ‘require’, fi akkasumas akkaataa ‘essential’, ‘important’, ‘necessary’, ‘vital’, ‘crucial’, fi akkasumas akkaataa ‘requirement’, ‘suggestion’ jedhuu malee itti fayyadamu godhamee jira. Afaan Ispeenii dhiisuu, subjuntivoo fi’ii dha (hable, hables, hable...), afaan Ingilizii garuu, fi’ii tokko duubatti hin jiru. Akkasumas, akkaataa hin jiru maqii tokko duubatti (he goes, it is), garuu, akkasumas akkaataa formaalaa fi akadeemikii keessatti subjuntivoo godhu hin jiru. Akkasumas, akkaataa ‘should’ jedhuu malee itti fayyadamu godhamee jira (It is essential that he should be), garuu, akkasumas akkaataa Britaanichii fi formaalaa godhamee jira. Subjuntivoo Ingiliziin akkasumas akkaataa ‘lest’ jedhuu malee itti fayyadamu godhamee jira (raro) fi akkasumas akkaataa ‘God save the Queen’ jedhuu malee itti fayyadamu godhamee jira.

title: Future Perfect and Continuous / Gaaddisaa Dhumaati fi Gaaddisaa Itti Fufuu
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, gaaddisaa sadarkaa akkasuma gaaddisaa itti fufuu kan nama hubatan gaaddisaa xixinnoo barbaachisaa qabnu dha. Gaaddisaa dhumaati (will have + gaafadhu) 'habré + gaafadhu' kana afaan Ispeenichii akkasumas gaaddisaa itti fufuu (will be + -ing) 'estaré haciendo' kana afaan Ispeenichii akkasumas barbaachisaa qabnu dha. Gaaddisaa dhumaati kan gaafadhuu dhumaachuu qabnu akkasumas gaaddisaa itti fufuu kan gaafadhuu itti fufuu qabnu barbaachisaa qabnu dha.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, gaaddisaa dhumaati 'will have' + gaafadhuu dhumaachuu qabnu dha. Gaaddisaa itti fufuu 'will be' + gaafadhuu itti fufuu qabnu dha. Gaaddisaa dhumaati kan gaafadhuu dhumaachuu qabnu akkasumas gaaddisaa itti fufuu kan gaafadhuu itti fufuu qabnu barbaachisaa qabnu dha.

title: Discourse Markers for Cohesion / Miilla murtii kan ta'e hojii keessan argamuu
bridge: Afaan Oromoo keessummaa, miilla murtii kan ta'e hojii (kan ‘hata’iti’, ‘haa ta’ee’, ‘garuu’) malee qorichaa qaban akkasumas walii tokko tokkoo hojjetan dandeenya. Afaan Ingiliffii keessummaa garuu, miilla murtii kan ta'e hojii kun qorichaa tokkoo duuba’uu danda’an akkasumas gaaffii akkasumas utuu hin qabanneef. Fakkeenyaaf, ‘however’ (kan ‘hata’iti’) qorichaa guutamoo, seentaa akkasumas murtoo jiraatan danda’u; garuu ‘although’ (kan ‘iti maal goota’) gochuu sirrii ta’e hojii akkasumas qorichaa tokkoo hin dandeessan. ‘Therefore’ (kan ‘haa ta’ee’) akkasumas ‘so’ (kan ‘haa ta’ee’) dhufan irra deebii akkuma hin qabanneef: ‘so’ gaaffii murtoo jiraachuudha; ‘therefore’ garuu gaaffii qorichaa jiraachuudha.
rule: Miilla murtii kan ta'e hojii Afaan Ingiliffii (B2) seentota lamaa ta’an: miilla murtii sirrii ta’e hojii (furthermore, moreover, in addition), miilla murtii hojii uume (however, nevertheless, on the other hand, whereas), miilla murtii sababii/netee (therefore, consequently, as a result, thus), miilla murtii seentota (firstly, secondly, finally, meanwhile), akkasumas miilla murtii hojii walqixxummaa (in other words, that is to say). Seeraa tokko tokko: 1) ‘However’ kan murtoo jiraataa ta’e hojii qorichaa guutamoo, seentaa akkasumas murtoo jiraatan danda’u. Fakkeenya: ‘The weather was bad. However, we went out.’ / ‘The weather was bad. We went out, however.’ 2) ‘Although’ kan gochuu sirrii ta’e hojii ta’e hojii sirrii ta’e hojii akkasumas qorichaa tokkoo hin dandeessan; garuu sirrii ta’e hojii qorichaa tokkoo dandeessan: ‘Although it was raining, we went out’ (qorichaa tokkoo ‘although’ hin dandeessan). 3) ‘Therefore’ akkasumas ‘consequently’ gaaffii qorichaa jiraatan; ‘so’ garuu gaaffii murtoo jiraachuudha. 4) ‘On the other hand’ hojii lamaa ta’e hojii akkasumas ‘however’ hin jiran. 5) Afaan Ingiliffii keessummaa, qoricha murtoo jiraataa ta’e hojii tokko tokko duuba’uu danda’u (fakkeenya: ‘It was raining; however, we went out’). 6) Miilla murtii seentota (‘firstly’, ‘secondly’, ‘finally’) qorichaa guutamoo jiraatan akkasumas gaaffii qorichaa jiraatan.

title: Hedging Language / Afaan hedging
bridge: Afaan Espaanii, hanga irra deebii akkas jedhanii yookiin ‘parece que’ akkas jedhanii haa isaanitti dhaga’uudha. Afaan Ingilizii, hedging verbi modaalota, afaan maaliwwan akkas jedhanii irra deebii akkas jedhanii haa isaanitti dhaga’uudha. Dhugaa tokko tokko akkas jedha ‘tiendo a’ akkas jedhamutti ‘tend to’ akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e, akkasumas ‘apparently’ akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e, ‘seemingly’ akkas jedhamu yoo dhiisuudha. Kana malee, akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e, akkasumas ‘seemingly’ akkas jedhamu yoo dhiisuudha. Kana malee, akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e, akkasumas ‘seemingly’ akkas jedhamu yoo dhiisuudha.
rule: Hedging afaan Ingilizii irra deebii akkas jedhanii yookiin afaan maaliwwan akkas jedhanii haa isaanitti dhaga’uudha. 1) Verbi modaalota: may, might, could, can. Fakkeenya: 'It might rain' (Puede que llueva). 2) Afaan maaliwwan akkas jedhanii yookiin afaan maaliwwan akkas jedhanii: usually, generally, apparently, presumably. Fakkeenya: 'Apparently, he left early' (Aparentemente, se fue temprano). 3) Verbi maaliwwan akkas jedhanii: I think, I believe, I suppose, I tend to think. Fakkeenya: 'I tend to agree with you' (Tiendo a estar de acuerdo contigo). 4) Afaan maaliwwan akkas jedhanii: It seems that, It appears that, It is said that. Fakkeenya: 'It seems that she is tired' (Parece que ella está cansada). 5) Sirna ‘tend to’ + infinitivo sirnaa kanaa yookiin sirnaa kanaa. Fakkeenya: 'He tends to arrive late' (Suele llegar tarde). 6) 'Apparently' sirnaa kanaa yookiin sirnaa kanaa, 'seemingly' sirnaa kanaa yookiin sirnaa kanaa. 7) 'Rather' akkasumas 'quite' maaliwwan akkas jedhanii haa isaanitti dhaga’uudha. Fakkeenya: 'It's rather expensive' (Es bastante caro). 8) Sirnaa baraa, 'would seem' akkasumas 'could be argued' haa isaanitti dhaga’uudha. Akkasumas, afaan Espaanii 'parece que' akkas jedhamutti subjuntivo haa isaanitti dhaga’uudha, afaan Ingilizii 'It seems that he is sick' (Parece que está enfermo) akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e.

examples.original: Could you help me with this problem?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː hɛlp miː wɪð ðɪs ˈprɒbləm/
examples.translation: Inni mul’ii kanarraa dhaga’aa?
examples.note: 'Could' 'can' akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e, 'can' akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e.

examples.original: This could be the best option for us.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd biː ðə bɛst ˈɒpʃən fɔːr ʌs/
examples.translation: Kana malee, akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e, akkasumas 'could' akkas jedhamu yoo ta’e.
examples.note: 'Could' sirnaa kanaa yookiin sirnaa kanaa, sirnaa kanaa yookiin sirnaa kanaa.

examples.original: It seems that the prices have increased significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈpraɪsɪz hæv ˈɪnkriːst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Inni cuqaa kanarraa itti dhaga’ee ta’ee akkas jedha.
examples.note: 'It seems that' + indicativo, subjuntivo akkas jedhamutti afaan Espaanii.

examples.original: I tend to agree with the new policy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ tɛnd tuː əˈɡriː wɪð ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi/
examples.translation: Inni sirrii barreeffata kanarraa itti dhaga’ee ta’ee akkas jedha.
examples.note: 'Tend to' sirnaa baraa yookiin sirnaa baraa, 'soler' akkas jedhamutti afaan Espaanii.

examples.original: She appears to be very confident.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː əˈpɪərz tuː biː ˈvɛri ˈkɒnfɪdənt/
examples.translation: Inni sirrii kanatti fuulaa’ee akkas jedha.
examples.note: 'Appears to' sirnaa kanaa yookiin sirnaa kanaa, 'parece' akkas jedhamutti afaan Espaanii.
